lede: Q MotorWorkz is an independent car workshop at WCEGA Plaza in Bukit Batok. Its own website lists accident claims, diagnostics, repairs and aircon work for European, Japanese and Korean cars.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention photos of old and new parts, transparent prices, a car overhaul, a clutch pump fix for a van, quick troubleshooting and fair prices for private hire drivers.
faqs: Google Maps lists it as a car repair workshop.
The hours are listed in the Google Maps section above. Please see Google Maps for current hours.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website.
makes_note: Its website says it works on European, Japanese and Korean makes.
good_to_know: Book a slot by WhatsApp or phone, according to its website
Its website says no work starts until the customer approves it in writing or on WhatsApp
